selected_boundary.authority: SGIS-derived community dataset, not official-current certification
selected_boundary.attribution: 통계청 SGIS 행정동 경계(공공누리 제1유형)를 가공한 vuski/admdongkor, CC BY 4.0
selected_boundary.cleanup_policy: Sort adm_cd2 ordinal; each region owns its original polygon minus the union of earlier owners. Record every overlap change. Preserve all positive-area fragments. Assert original union equals cleaned union within 0.01 m2 and every source region remains nonempty.
selected_boundary.precision_policy: No arbitrary translation, coordinate snapping, area deletion, convex hull or gap filling. Canonical polygon calculation in EPSG:5179. Display simplification is separate from canonical geometry.

comparison_boundary.policy: Retain dated comparison and source-only fragments as discrepancy overlays. Do not import 2013-only areas as current Seoul or silently omit selected-boundary-only areas.

osm.policy: No name-only deduplication; preserve type and object ID. All candidate nodes/ways/relations accounted; missing geometry quarantined, not counted outside. Preserve stop order without shortcut edges.

terrain.observation_date_reason: S3 modification is not the SRTM/GMTED2010/ETOPO1 observation date.
terrain.policy: Read per-tile dates/CRS/sha/nodata from original manifest and retain missing observations as unknown.

decision_kind: implementation default for full-area regional content, not legal boundary certification
reason: Named dated 427 dongs provide finer local identity than 25 gu or anonymous grid. Original district mask has a large measured discrepancy and includes external stations. New union is explicitly selected and both versions remain traceable.
